headline: Binance Hit by Reported $6.3 Billion Crypto Hack
summary: Hackers diverted an estimated $6.3 billion of digital assets from Binance in what is described as the largest crypto heist in history, with stolen Bitcoin likely unrecoverable.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Major security breaches impact market liquidity, regulatory scrutiny, and investor sentiment across digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: News of the largest cryptocurrency exchange hack involving billions in assets dampens crypto asset prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar breach at the world's largest crypto exchange raises systemic counterparty and security fears across digital assets, prompting selloffs.
